composition.historicalScarcity: Saved reports contain only one usable genuine historical failure (r5 Q17). The r5 gate triage classed 47 of 48 recorded failures as evaluator false positives; r5 A02 r3 (guessed date) was excluded because the guessed date sits inside an instruction, not a record assertion. Hence 7 controlled perturbations, each labelled and never presented as model output.

packageRules: question, final answer (full, never truncated), reference clock + time zone, every tool payload the answer had, citations, and turn receipts — all from saved reports
perturbations change ONE answer span only; sources untouched; the original answer is kept in the package record; the reviewer request carries no origin label
citations are kept in the package for the deterministic citation checks but are NOT sent to the semantic reviewer — citation identity/scope stays a hard check
prerequisitesBeforeAnyPaidRequest: Independent adjudication of the 7 PROPOSED reference units (FA-C01, M03, M04, M06, M07, M08x2) using fullanswer-v1-reference-audit-packet.json; any changed reference is recorded before the run, never after
Recommended: independent audit of the 5 calibration matching decisions (reviewer-pilot-v2-independent-audit-packet.json); until then the calibration adjudication is reported as unconfirmed

scoring.claimLevel: E1–E8 exactly as in the calibration; reference units are claim-level (span, subject, temporal scope, source field, verdict, reason)
scoring.coverage: span overlap only nominates; coverage requires the same subject, content, polarity and temporal scope; unclear matches are adjudication_required and never auto-pass; an ASSERTED reference unit labelled NON_ASSERTION by the reviewer is E4; coverage.allTextReviewed is not evidence
scoring.sourceRefs: resolved against the sources sent, or against receipts when the path starts with 'receipts.'; unresolvable → E6
answerLevel: perturbation detection: each of the 7 perturbed claims judged CONTRADICTED (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE counts as E2)
no false alarm on the 8 supported answers (E3 = 0 expected)
whole-answer coverage: omissions per answer, a correct claim never offsets an omitted one
KD-1 recurrence: E5 caused by presupposition / conditional consequent, counted separately

proposedGoNoGo.status: PROPOSED — requires approval; signals only, not acceptance

outputEstimate.method: calibration-derived: 250 + 1.3 x reference units x 400 tokens per package (thinking included)

optionA_frozenMaxTokens.risk: predicted truncation (E8) on the 8-claim packages FA-M03 and FA-M04; E8 fails the go/no-go for a configuration reason

optionB_ceilingOnlyDeviation.note: max_tokens is a ceiling; thinking depth is governed by effort (unchanged at medium), so responses that fit under 4000 are unaffected. Still a recorded deviation from the frozen configuration that needs explicit approval.

stopRules: before each request: counted input x1.05 + max_tokens must fit remaining requests/input/output/dollars, else stop INCOMPLETE
401/403 or credit error → BLOCKED; no provider change, no top-up
stop_reason max_tokens → saved as E8, not retried or continued
one attempt per package; no extra generation request
budget.previousApproval: the $2.20 approval covered the finished calibration only and does not extend here

limitations: exposed data + controlled perturbations — not a blind test

references written by the study runner; 7 units await independent adjudication
